With the ignition on, when the windscreen wiper control is operated in the various positions it does not work and the windscrfeen is not washed;

the windscreen wiping and washing functions are managed by the steering wheel node (NVO) which receives commands from the right stalk lever.The networks go on stand-by 30 mins after the engine is switched off. This makes it impossible to carry out the fault diagnosis. If a diagnostic session has to be opened, start up the engine to reawaken the networks.
